answer: Hold pseudonym parties. At one shared moment each quarter, every operator must show up in person at some local gathering, where volunteers make sure each attendee leaves with exactly one fresh signing token; since all parties run at the same hour, nobody can attend two. A farm owner on a remote island still gets one token, however many clones its servers host. The beacon announcing the hour stays secret until shortly before, so proxies can't be staged everywhere, and emission nectar flows only to keys bound to a token.
